newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower as cross-holdings unravel.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower as cross-holdings unravel.

text.p: Tokyo stocks lost ground on Monday as shares, especially in the construction sector, were hurt by sales aimed at dissolving cross-shareholdings.
A sharp decline in Wall Street stocks on Friday invited selling of blue chips in Tokyo to collect profits, also accelerating the overall downturn, brokers said.
They said a bearish tone may continue to undermine the market for another few weeks.
The 225-share Nikkei average shed 154.51 points or 0.87 percent to close at 17,692.47. It briefly slid to as low as 17,547.35. Its June futures ended 190 points lower at 17,640.
